# File Resource

## Summary
Base-realm generic file renderer — the catch-all presentation for any
FileDef-backed file. Lives at
`https://cardstack.com/base/file-formats/file-resources` (named export
`FileResource`, alongside `FileAudio`, `FileVideo`, and `FileObject`).

## Usage
```gts
import { FileResource } from 'https://cardstack.com/base/file-formats/file-resources';

<FileResource @model={{this.file}} />
```
File renderers take a FileDef-backed model (an uploaded realm file) — an
example instance requires an actual uploaded file, so these specs document
the contract and defer live examples to a file-fixtures pass (flagged for
review).
